title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: CDR > EAC > WavMerge > CD-Wave > Soundforge > TLH > FLAC.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience field recording captures a high‑energy fall‑tour show with the debut of Touch of Grey, a thunderous Phil chant into a monster Other One, and crisp, immersive soundstage.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its vibrant vibe – from the fresh excitement of Touch of Grey to the soaring Phil chant that erupts into an unforgettable Other One. Reviewers note the field‑recorded audio is surprisingly clear and three‑dimensional, making it a standout listening experience despite a minor comment about Jerry’s vocal subtlety.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings (mostly 5 stars) and enthusiastic comments on both the musical performance and the surprisingly excellent audience recording lead to a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe an immersive 3D soundstage, crisp clarity for a field recording, and overall superb audio fidelity; no major dropouts or balance issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early new songs felt a bit tentative, but the second set surged with energy – Phil chant, massive Other One and sustained crowd excitement carried the show to a high point.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His vocal subtlety was noted as slightly diminished, though he still gave his all on the songs.
band_member_comments.Phil: Crowd‑led Phil chant sparked "major bombs" from him, highlighting a powerful bass performance.
